thread:
Asha Verma: hi all — Asha here, first day on Platform. Trying the quickstart in europe-west4 but hitting permission issues listing VMs and also the project shows no billing account. Who should I ping for region and billing perms? :wave:

Asha Verma: gcloud error:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.list) PERMISSION_DENIED: User does not have permission to list instances on project redwood-eu-experiments
```

Toni_IT: welcome Asha! :tada: Did onboarding add you to infra-eu or just the base engineering SSO group? infra-eu is needed for most EU project viewer roles.

Asha Verma: only engineering per the invite. I followed the quickstart and assumed the project would be linked to billing automatically.

Sam_CloudOps: hi Asha — quick checks: 1) confirm project ancestors, 2) check billing link, 3) see if your email appears in project IAM after SSO sync. Run these:```
gcloud projects get-ancestors redwood-eu-experiments --format="value(ancestor)"
gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-eu-experiments --format="value(billingAccountName)"
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-experiments --filter=bindings.members:asha.verma@redwood.com --format=json
```

Asha Verma: pasted ancestors: `organizations/9876543210\nfolders/9999999\nprojects/redwood-eu-experiments`

Sam_CloudOps: folder 9999999 is our eu-shared folder — good. If the billing command returns empty then the project wasn't linked. Also SSO can take ~10m to propagate; if `get-iam-policy` returns empty we need an SSO add.

Asha Verma: billing describe returned nothing, and IAM check returned `[]`.

Toni_IT: thanks for the checks. Opening ONB-1001 to add you to infra-eu and to request billing linking. infra-bot will track.

infra-bot: Ticket ONB-1001 created by toni_it for user Asha Verma — "Add infra-eu SSO + attach billing account for redwood-eu-experiments". Priority: P2. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-1001

Sam_CloudOps: while IT processes that, I can grant a short-lived `roles/compute.viewer` so you can finish the quickstart. I'll set it to expire in 2 hours.

Sam_CloudOps: granted `roles/compute.viewer` on redwood-eu-experiments to asha.verma@redwood.com (expires in 2h).

Asha Verma: listing works now, I can see the tiny test VM and SSH in. Huge help, thanks! :relieved:

Asha Verma: curious — why would a project under eu-shared not be linked to billing? quickstart said it should inherit billing.

Toni_IT: two reasons we've seen: 1) Project created via CLI with a different parent argument so it didn't inherit folder policies, 2) delayed ops automation that links new projects. We'll attach billing and update the automation.

Asha Verma: any quick CLI to re-check once billing is attached? want to update my onboarding notes.

Sam_CloudOps: after link run:```
gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-eu-experiments --format="value(billingAccountName)"```
If it prints `billingAccounts/...` you're linked. Also check console Billing -> Billing accounts.

Asha Verma: noted. small onboarding suggestion: the quickstart should include a one-liner to verify ancestor folder + billing link and warn about SSO propagation delays. Saved me a bit of confusion.

Toni_IT: good point — adding that to the onboarding checklist now. We'll include the three CLI commands Sam posted.

infra-bot: ONB-1001 updated: infra-eu SSO add requested; billing attach queued.

Sam_CloudOps: billing attached by ops. Please run the billing describe check and let us know.

Asha Verma: confirmed: `billingAccounts/4455-6677-8899` now shows. AWS billing still not relevant to my current tests. All good from my side, thanks everyone and happy to be here! :sparkles:
